He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State Sun Devils]] and [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]].{{Cite web |date=2025-04-08 |title=Quaintance commits to Kentucky for 2nd time |url=https://www.espn.com/espngamer/ncb/story/_/id/44586018/ex-arizona-state-star-jayden-quaintance-re-commits-kentucky |access-date=2025-04-08 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}{{cite web |last1=Black |first1=Ryan |title=Kentucky's Jayden Quaintance picked by San Antonio Spurs in NBA draft |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/kentucky/2026/06/23/nba-draft-2026-jayden-quaintance-san-antonio-spurs-kentucky-basketball-arizona-state-uk-wildcats/90423157007/?gca-cat=p&gnt-cfr=1 |website=The Courier-Journal |access-date=24 June 2026}} ==Early life and high school== Quaintance grew up in [[Cleveland, Ohio]].{{cite web|url=https://www.cleveland.com/highschoolsports/2022/09/cvcas-darryn-peterson-cleveland-native-jayden-quaintance-invited-to-usa-basketball-junior-national-team-camp.html|title=CVCA's Darryn Peterson, Cleveland native Jayden Quaintance invited to USA Basketball Junior National Team minicamp|first=Matt|last=Goul|website=[[Cleveland.com]]|date=September 22, 2022|access-date=March 21, 2024}} He moved to [[Phoenix, Arizona]] before the start of high school and enrolled at Hillcrest Prep.{{cite web|url=https://duckswire.usatoday.com/lists/dana-altman-extends-offer-to-4-star-center-jayden-quanintance-in-class-of-2025/|title=Dana Altman extends offer to 4-star center Jayden Quanintance in class of 2025|first=Andy|last=Patton|website=Ducks Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=October 12, 2022|access-date=March 21, 2024}} Quaintance transferred again to [[Word of God Christian Academy]] in [[Raleigh, North Carolina]] before his sophomore year.{{cite web|url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-recruiting/article278609154.html|title=More five-star recruits set visits to Kentucky basketball, and other UK recruiting news.|first=Cameron|last=Drummond|work=[[Lexington Herald Leader]]|date=August 29, 2023|access-date=April 6, 2024}} He also reclassified from the class of 2025 to 2024.{{cite web|url=https://www.on3.com/teams/kentucky-wildcats/news/jayden-quaintance-talks-reclass-decision-kentucky-offer-it-seems-like-a-good-fit/|title=Jayden Quaintance talks reclass decision, Kentucky offer: "It seems like a good fit"|first=Jack|last=Pilgrim|website=On3.com|date=July 29, 2023|access-date=April 6, 2024}} Quaintance was selected to play in the [[2024 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] during his senior year.{{cite web|url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-recruiting/article287295200.html|title=McDonald's All-American Game featured three future Kentucky players. Here's who impressed.|first=Cameron|last=Drummond|work=[[Lexington Herald Leader]]|date=April 3, 2024|access-date=April 6, 2024}} ===Recruiting=== Quaintance was a consensus five-star recruit and one of the top players in the 2024 class, according to major recruiting services.{{cite web|url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2023/08/07/native-ohioan-jayden-quaintance-considering-ohio-state-in-2024-class/70540034007/|title=Five-star native Ohioan Jayden Quaintance considering Ohio State in 2024 class|first=Adam|last=Jardy|work=[[The Columbus Dispatch]]|date=August 7, 2023|access-date=March 21, 2024}}{{cite web|url=https://www.columbiamissourian.com/sports/mizzou_mens_basketball/top-10-prospect-quaintance-lists-mizzou-as-finalist/article_67eab1ae-8005-11ee-8011-57c8a0a78ac8.html|title=Top-10 prospect Quaintance lists Mizzou as finalist|first=Christian Riley|last=Dutcher|work=[[Columbia Missourian]]|date=November 10, 2023|access-date=March 21, 2024}} He committed to play college basketball at Kentucky over offers from Missouri, Florida, South Florida, and Ohio State.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/38896975/kentucky-improves-recruiting-class-jayden-quaintance|title=Kentucky improves recruiting class with Jayden Quaintance|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=November 14, 2023|access-date=March 21, 2024}} Quaintance signed a [[National Letter of Intent]] (NLI) to play for the Wildcats on November 15, 2023, during the early signing period.{{cite web|url=https://www.aseaofblue.com/2023/11/15/23963207/jayden-quaintance-travis-perry-kentucky-wildcats-basketball|title=Jayden Quaintance and Travis Perry officially sign with Kentucky|first=Adam|last=Haste|website=ASeaOfBlue.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=November 15, 2023|access-date=April 11, 2024}} However, he requested a release from his NLI on April 10, 2024, shortly after Kentucky head coach [[John Calipari]] left the program to become the head coach at [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]].{{cite web|url=https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2024/apr/10/5-star-center-requests-release-from-kentucky-nli/|title=5-star center requests release from Kentucky NLI|work=[[Arkansas Democrat-Gazette]]|date=April 10, 2024|access-date=April 11, 2024}} On April 29, 2024, Quaintance announced his commitment to [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State]]. == College career == Quaintance played one season with Arizona State, averaging 9.4 points and 7.9 rebounds per game over 24 games.{{Cite web |title=Jayden Quaintance College Stats |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/jayden-quaintance-1.html |access-date=2025-05-19 |website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com |language=en}} In February 2025, he injured his knee and missed the remainder of the season. He had knee surgery on March 19.{{Cite web |date=2025-04-02 |title=ASU's Quaintance has knee surgery, eyes portal |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/44504710/arizona-state-jayden-quaintance-knee-surgery-eyes-portal |access-date=2025-05-19 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} Following the season, he entered the [[NCAA transfer portal|transfer portal]].{{Cite web |date=2025-04-02 |title=Why Jayden Quaintance, Arizona State's star 17-year-old, is the most unique transfer portal entrant ever |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/why-jayden-quaintance-arizona-states-star-17-year-old-would-be-the-most-unique-transfer-portal-entrant-ever/ |access-date=2025-05-19 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}} He later announced he would transfer to Kentucky, where he had originally committed to play his freshman year.{{Cite web |last=O'Reilly |first=Alexander |date=2025-05-07 |title=Mark Pope's latest transfer portal addition, Jayden Quaintance sends clear message ahead of first season with Kentucky |url=https://www.sportskeeda.com/college-basketball/news-mark-pope-s-latest-transfer-portal-addition-jayden-quaintance-sends-clear-message-ahead-first-season-with-kentucky |access-date=2025-05-19 |website=www.sportskeeda.com |language=en-us}} Following the healing of his injury, Quaintance made his Wildcats debut on December 20, 2025, where he posted 10 points, eight rebounds, and two blocks in 17 minutes of playtime against the [[St. John's Red Storm men's basketball|St. John's Red Storm]].{{cite news |first=Cole|last=Parke|title=Jayden Quaintance makes immediate impact in Kentucky debut |url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/article/kentucky-basketball-jayden-quaintance-debut-267321888/ |work=[[247Sports]] |date=December 20, 2025 |access-date=June 24, 2026}} Following his debut, Quaintance would go on to play four games in a row until he was sidelined on January 7, 2026, following further issues and swelling in his leg. On February 17, 2026, Quaintance suffered a [[torn meniscus]] and was sidelined indefinitely, and was not permitted to participate in any activities.{{cite news |first=Chris|last=Beasmore|title=Jayden Quaintance makes immediate impact in Kentucky debut |url=https://www.aseaofblue.com/kentucky-wildcats-basketball/161635/jayden-quaintance-injury-shut-down |work=A Sea Of Blue |date=January 29, 2026 |access-date=June 24, 2026}}{{cite news |title=Jayden Quaintance is a long-term bet for San Antonio |url=https://www.poundingtherock.com/spurs-draft-rumors-news-analysis/105570/jayden-quaintance-is-a-long-term-bet-for-san-antonio |work=Pounding The Rock |publisher=[[Vox Media]] |access-date=June 24, 2026}} On April 14, 2026, Quaintance declared for the [[2026 NBA Draft]].{{cite news |first=Colby|last=Wilson |title=Kentucky's Jayden Quaintance declares for 2026 NBA Draft |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/kentucky-jayden-quaintance-declares-2026-221514470.html |work=[[Yahoo Sports]] |date=April 14, 2026 |access-date=June 24, 2026}} Following his season at Kentucky, Quaintance only appeared in four total games. ==Professional career== ===San Antonio Spurs (2026–present)=== On June 23, 2026, Quaintance was selected with the 20th overall pick by the [[San Antonio Spurs]] in the [[2026 NBA draft]].{{cite news |title=Jayden Quaintance selected by the Spurs with the No. 20 pick in 2026 NBA Draft |url=https://www.on3.com/teams/kentucky-wildcats/news/jayden-quaintance-selected-by-the-spurs-with-the-no-20-pick-in-2026-nba-draft/ |work=[[On3]]|date=June 23, 2026 |access-date=June 24, 2026}} On July 6, 2026, the [[San Antonio Spurs]] announced that they had signed Quaintance.{{cite web|title=Spurs sign 2026 Draft Class|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-sign-2026-draft-class|date=July 6, 2026|website=NBA.com|access-date=July 6, 2026}} On July 15, the Spurs announced that Quaintance had undergone successful surgery on his right meniscus.{{cite web|title=Spurs injury update – 7.15.26|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-injury-update-7-15-26|date=July 16, 2026|website=NBA.com|access-date=July 16, 2026}} ==National team career== Quaintance played for the [[United States men's national under-17 basketball team|United States national under-16 team]] at the 2023 [[FIBA Under-16 Americas Championship]]. He averaged 6.7 points and 6.5 rebounds in six games as the United States won the gold medal.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/recruiting/basketball/story/_/id/39915633/sources-jayden-quaintance-wants-kentucky-commitment|title=Sources: Jayden Quaintance wants out of Kentucky commitment|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=April 10, 2024|access-date=April 12, 2024}} ==Personal life== Quaintance's father, Haminn Quaintance, played college basketball at Jacksonville and Kent State.{{cite web|url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2023/09/11/ohio-state-official-visit-surprised-jayden-quaintances-family/70824348007/|title=Ohio State official visit surprised Jayden Quaintance's family|first=Adam|last=Jardy|work=[[The Columbus Dispatch]]|date=September 11, 2023|access-date=March 21, 2024}} In his free time, Quaintance enjoys playing chess and watching [[anime]]. His favorite anime is ''[[One Piece]]''. {{Cite web |date=2025-07-11 |title=Jayden Quaintance |url=https://ukathletics.com/roster/jayden-quaintance/ |access-date=2025-12-28 |website=UK Athletics |language=en-US}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://thesundevils.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/jayden-quaintance/16641 Arizona State Sun Devils bio] *[https://ukathletics.com/sports/mbball/roster/season/2025-26/player/jayden-quaintance/ Kentucky Wildcats bio] {{San Antonio Spurs current roster}} {{2026 NBA draft}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Quaintance, Jayden}} [[Category:2007 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Cleveland]] [[Category:Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball players]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Power forwards]] [[Category:San Antonio Spurs draft picks]] [[Category:Word of God Christian Academy alumni]]
